articles.text: Black Uru FormSP1 or the chosen starting Form activates Black Uru, the default starting Form; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Buff ending on the Opponent, Debuff immunity or Light interrupts of Basic Attacks pause it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Black Uru Form duration, entered by SP1 or starting-Form selection; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends its duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Black Uru Form synergy: The Green Door

articles.text: Crit Through BlockCritical Hits can pass through Block only in Refined Black Uru, reached by re-entry, sufficient Charge consumption via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.
CrueltyPassive SP3 grants indefinite Cruelty increasing Critical Damage Rating, with additional Cruelty if a Refined Form is already active, subject to a stack cap.
Gain PowerBlocking a hit reduces the Opponent's Ability Power Rate and transfers the denied Power to Absorbing Man until he stops blocking.

Magma FormSP2 or the chosen starting Form activates Magma; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Buff ending on the Opponent, Debuff immunity or Light interrupts of Basic Attacks pause it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Magma Form duration, entered by SP2 or starting-Form selection; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends its duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Magma Form synergy: The Green Door

articles.text: Morph ChargeActivating a Special after the preceding attack's opening hit lands grants Morph Charges and carries that attack's bonus Critical Rating into the Special; the qualifying preceding attack and its Stun condition are unspecified.Refreshing or changing Forms grants Morph Charges based on the previous Form's remaining duration; sufficient Charges are consumed by MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives.Being immune to an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff grants Morph Charges; sufficient Charges are consumed by MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives.

PauseOmni-Morph Forms — Interrupting the Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack temporarily pauses the current Form and inflicts a temporary Vulnerability Passive, subject to a stack cap.Omni-Morph Forms — A Buff ending on the Opponent or Absorbing Man being immune to a Debuff temporarily pauses his current Form.SP3 activates the most recent Form in its Refined state and pauses it, granting Critical Rating only during that pause.SynergyBlack TarantulaPuñO Cerrado — Punishing a Special Attack with a Light Attack temporarily pauses Omni-Morph Forms through this synergy; duplicate synergies do not stack.
Pre-Fight AbilityChoose the starting Form in the Pre-Fight Menu, with Black Uru as the default; the choice persists until changed.

Refined Black Uru FormRe-enter Black Uru or consume sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine it; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, starting-Form selection alone does not Refine, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Refined Black Uru duration, reached by re-entry or sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Refined Black Uru Form synergy: The Green Door

articles.text: Refined Magma FormRe-enter Magma or consume sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine it; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, starting-Form selection alone does not Refine, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Refined Magma duration, reached by re-entry or sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Refined Magma Form synergy: The Green Door

articles.text: RegenerationPassive Signature ability: consuming Morph Charges grants temporary, non-stacking Regeneration based on missing Health, also triggered by entering or refreshing a Form as a Defender; True Damage hits pause personal Regeneration, and early Form deactivation from a Heavy hit during Special recovery removes it.

UnblockablePassive Molecular Duplication - Always Active — Special Attacks are Unblockable in a Refined Form, reached by re-entering the active Form, consuming sufficient Charges with MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.

buttons.label: Read Unblockable: Molecular Duplication - Always Active

articles.text: Ability Power Rate ReductionBlocking a hit reduces the Opponent's Ability Power Rate until Absorbing Man stops blocking.

Armor BreakSynergyThorThor (Jane Foster)Debuff The Worthy — This synergy lets the second Medium Attack inflict temporary Armor Break on the Opponent, subject to a stack cap; duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Armor Break synergy: The Worthy

articles.text: AtrophyAbsorbing Man shortens the Opponent's Indestructible, Immortality, Unstoppable and Unblockable Buffs.

Burst DamageBlack Uru attacks deal Physical Damage bursts whose Ability Accuracy cannot be modified and which benefit from Critical Damage on Critical Hits; Refined bursts can trigger through Block and be Critical, while a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown and signature extends its duration.Magma attacks deal Energy Damage bursts whose Ability Accuracy cannot be modified and which benefit from Critical Damage on Critical Hits; Refined bursts can be Critical, while a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown and signature extends its duration.SynergyThe SerpentThe Main Event — For Absorbing Man as a #Cul's Worthy recipient, this synergy strengthens Black Uru Physical bursts; Refined bursts can trigger through Block and be Critical, their Ability Accuracy cannot be modified, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown, and duplicate synergies do not stack.For Absorbing Man as a #Cul's Worthy recipient, this synergy strengthens Magma Energy bursts; their Ability Accuracy cannot be modified, Critical Hits enhance them, Refined bursts can be Critical, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Burst Damage synergy: The Main Event

articles.text: Energy DamageMorph Charges — In Magma or Refined Magma Form, all attacks deal Energy instead of Physical Damage; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.

IncineratePassive Morph Charges — Contact with the Opponent inflicts Incinerate Passives only in Refined Magma, reached by re-entering Magma, consuming sufficient Charges with MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.

VulnerabilityPassive A Medium-Light-Medium combo with sufficient Morph Charges, or a Special Attack at maximum Charges, consumes available Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives based on Charges spent.Passive Omni-Morph Forms — Interrupting the Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack inflicts a temporary Vulnerability Passive, subject to a stack cap, and temporarily pauses the current Form.

Ability Accuracy ModificationImmunityOmni-Morph Forms — Form changes cannot fail due to Ability Accuracy Modification; this protection applies only to Form changes.Omni-Morph Forms — Absorbing Man's personal damage bursts cannot have their Ability Accuracy modified.

buttons.label: Read Ability Accuracy Modification: Omni-Morph Forms
Read Ability Accuracy Modification: Omni-Morph Forms

articles.text: Armor BreakImmunityDebuff
Armor ShatterImmunityDebuff

BleedImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Bleed only while Black Uru or Refined Black Uru is active; SP1 or the starting-Form choice enters Black Uru, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.

ColdsnapImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Coldsnap only in Magma or Refined Magma Form, entered through SP2 or the starting-Form choice; re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.

DebuffsResistanceSynergyRogueduration reduction· See source conditionsHands-On Approach — This synergy shortens Non-Damaging Debuffs on Absorbing Man, excluding Stuns; duplicate synergies do not stack.Synergy values · 7★Absorbing Man: Reduce the duration of Non-Damaging Debuffs other than Stuns by 50%.

FrostbiteImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Frostbite only while Magma or Refined Magma is active; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.

IncinerateImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Incinerate only while Magma or Refined Magma is active; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.
PoisonImmunitySynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy grants Absorbing Man Poison immunity and extends Omni-Morph Form duration; duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Poison synergy: The Green Door

articles.text: ShockImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Shock only in Black Uru or Refined Black Uru Form, entered through SP1 or the starting-Form choice; re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.

articles.text: Black Uru FormSP1 or the chosen starting Form activates Black Uru, the default starting Form; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Buff ending on the Opponent, Debuff immunity or Light interrupts of Basic Attacks pause it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Black Uru Form duration, entered by SP1 or starting-Form selection; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends its duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Black Uru Form synergy: The Green Door

articles.text: Crit Through BlockCritical Hits can pass through Block only in Refined Black Uru, reached by re-entry, sufficient Charge consumption via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.
CrueltyPassive SP3 grants indefinite Cruelty increasing Critical Damage Rating, with additional Cruelty if a Refined Form is already active, subject to a stack cap.
Gain PowerBlocking a hit reduces the Opponent's Ability Power Rate and transfers the denied Power to Absorbing Man until he stops blocking.

Magma FormSP2 or the chosen starting Form activates Magma; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Buff ending on the Opponent, Debuff immunity or Light interrupts of Basic Attacks pause it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Magma Form duration, entered by SP2 or starting-Form selection; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends its duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Magma Form synergy: The Green Door

articles.text: Morph ChargeActivating a Special after the preceding attack's opening hit lands grants Morph Charges and carries that attack's bonus Critical Rating into the Special; the qualifying preceding attack and its Stun condition are unspecified.Refreshing or changing Forms grants Morph Charges based on the previous Form's remaining duration; sufficient Charges are consumed by MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives.Being immune to an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff grants Morph Charges; sufficient Charges are consumed by MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives.

PauseOmni-Morph Forms — Interrupting the Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack temporarily pauses the current Form and inflicts a temporary Vulnerability Passive, subject to a stack cap.Omni-Morph Forms — A Buff ending on the Opponent or Absorbing Man being immune to a Debuff temporarily pauses his current Form.SP3 activates the most recent Form in its Refined state and pauses it, granting Critical Rating only during that pause.SynergyBlack TarantulaPuñO Cerrado — Punishing a Special Attack with a Light Attack temporarily pauses Omni-Morph Forms through this synergy; duplicate synergies do not stack.
Pre-Fight AbilityChoose the starting Form in the Pre-Fight Menu, with Black Uru as the default; the choice persists until changed.

Refined Black Uru FormRe-enter Black Uru or consume sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine it; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, starting-Form selection alone does not Refine, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Refined Black Uru duration, reached by re-entry or sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

buttons.label: View Refined Black Uru Form synergy: The Green Door

buttons.label: View Refined Magma Form synergy: The Green Door

articles.text: RegenerationPassive Signature ability: consuming Morph Charges grants temporary, non-stacking Regeneration based on missing Health, also triggered by entering or refreshing a Form as a Defender; True Damage hits pause personal Regeneration, and early Form deactivation from a Heavy hit during Special recovery removes it.

IncineratePassive Morph Charges — Contact with the Opponent inflicts Incinerate Passives only in Refined Magma, reached by re-entering Magma, consuming sufficient Charges with MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.

VulnerabilityPassive A Medium-Light-Medium combo with sufficient Morph Charges, or a Special Attack at maximum Charges, consumes available Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives based on Charges spent.Passive Omni-Morph Forms — Interrupting the Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack inflicts a temporary Vulnerability Passive, subject to a stack cap, and temporarily pauses the current Form.
